releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.20

- Adds a private weekly comparison of complete Strava Top 10 snapshots and alerts when a previously listed segment disappears.
- Guides the user through copying each signed-in Top 10 results page; no Strava website scraping or unsupported background Top 20 discovery is performed.
- Opens a lost Top 10 segment for user-controlled review of the efforts ahead and never treats a leaderboard change alone as evidence of invalid activity data.
- Rejects empty or implausibly incomplete copied lists to prevent false mass-loss alerts.
- Preserves existing leaderboard review data while adding the new snapshot history.
